resources.string:
Cannot launch target app.

Package not found or not visible:
%1$s

Check that the target app is installed, TARGET_PACKAGE is correct, and AndroidManifest.xml contains a matching queries entry.

Compy cannot find an SD card. Make sure one is fully inserted. Compy can continue using its built-in storage for projects, but projects you create or modify will stay on this device instead of moving with an SD card.

Compy cannot use this SD card right now. Open maintenance, remove and reinsert the card, then try again. If the problem continues, use another card. Compy can continue using its built-in storage for projects, but projects you create or modify will stay on this device instead of moving with an SD card.

This SD card can save project files, but it is not prepared for Compy backups, updates, or recovery. Open maintenance to set it up. Without setup, your project files will be saved on the card normally, but those other features remain unavailable.

The Compy setup information on this SD card does not agree. Open maintenance and use Files to copy anything important. Use another card for backups, updates, and recovery. If you continue, your project files will be saved on the card normally, but those other features remain unavailable.

Compy can read this SD card but cannot save changes to it. Open maintenance, remove and reinsert the card, then try again. If the problem continues, use Files to copy anything important and replace the card. Compy can continue using its built-in storage for projects, but projects you create or modify will stay on this device instead of moving with an SD card.
Continue using built-in storage instead of the SD card?
Continue using this SD card for project files without backup, update, or recovery?
Compy IDE could not restart after the storage choice.
Choose an action. Progress and results appear here.
Android could not open this screen.
Stopping the current runtime before kiosk mode resumes.
Use Back to return to maintenance mode.
Use Back to return to maintenance mode.

Card identity:
%1$s

Initialization keeps these identity signals unchanged. If you track SD cards in inventory, verify that its record matches these values. Existing files are preserved only when they exactly match the product seed; a conflict stops the operation. Compy restarts once to verify every seeded file after the card remounts.
Creating the Compy layout and checking product seed files before restart…
Initialization is written. Compy is restarting to remount the SD card and verify the persisted files.
Initialization is written, but Compy could not restart automatically. Use the power menu to restart; verification will continue after startup.
Checking SD card %1$s byte-for-byte after restart…
Insert SD card %1$s and restart Compy to finish verification.
The SD card changed across restart and is not trusted. Replace it before use. Verification detail: %1$s

Copy every program from this SD card and both installed Compy apps into a snapshot on this SD card and on the Compy’s internal storage. The newest three unpinned snapshots from this card are kept on each destination.
Copying programs and installed apps from this SD card to the SD card and internal storage. Maintenance actions remain disabled until the snapshot is complete.
Snapshot #%1$d contains %2$d programs and both installed APKs. %3$d snapshot copies are retained for this card.
Automatic cleanup stopped on %1$d storage location(s). The completed snapshot and existing backup data were kept.
Internal storage has no Compy device identity. Create device ID %1$s for hardware serial %2$s, then continue creating the snapshot?
Writing and verifying the internal device identity before the snapshot continues.
Checking complete snapshots on the SD card and internal storage.
Create a snapshot before restoring programs.
Snapshot numbers increase for each source. The highest number for a source is listed first.
This snapshot is damaged or unreadable and cannot be restored. %1$s
Programs in this snapshot replace programs with the same name. Every replaced program is preserved with an .old name. Other programs remain in place.
Copying programs from the selected snapshot. Maintenance actions remain disabled until restore is complete.
Snapshot #%1$d restored %2$d program files and preserved %3$d replaced program trees.
This removes Compy kiosk ownership and leaves ordinary Android available. The device must be provisioned again before kiosk locking can resume.
Please wait. Maintenance actions are disabled until Android confirms the result.
Ordinary Android is available. Provision the launcher again before resuming kiosk locking.
